title: The high dimensional monostable reaction-diffusion equation with free boundary and radial symmetry
summary: We consider the radially symmetric version of the reaction-diffusion equation $u_t-dΔu=f(u)$ with a monostable nonlinearity $f$, viewed as a model for the spreading of a species with population range $r 0$ and $h'(t)=-d u_r(t,h(t))/δ$. For the one-dimensional case ($N=1$), Du \cite{DN} proved that when $δ\in(0,1)$, spreading occurs: $u\to1$ locally uniformly in $\mathbb{R}$, $h(t)\to\infty$, and $\lim_{t\to\infty}[h(t)-c_*t]=\tilde{h}\in\mathbb{R}$ with no logarithmic shift.
